description:
We are a team of enthusiastic first-year engineering students interested in technology, innovation, and problem-solving. Our project, "Field Shift – Adapting Farms with NASA Data," focuses on using NASA satellite data to help farmers understand soil and environmental conditions and make better farming decisions.
We are passionate about learning new technologies, exploring creative ideas, and developing solutions to real-world problems.
summary: AGRINOVA is a multilingual smart-farming assistant that helps farmers explore weather and soil conditions for a selected farm location. It offers crop suitability suggestions, farming guidance, and a text-and-voice question feature in English, Tamil, and Hindi.
details:
AGRINOVA — Project Details

Overview: AGRINOVA is a responsive, browser-based smart-farming assistant. It helps farmers review location-based weather and soil estimates, compare crops, and access basic farming guidance.

Main features

  • English, Tamil, and Hindi interface.
  • Farm location selection using GPS, an interactive map, and reverse geocoding.
  • Current weather, four-day forecast, and estimated near-surface soil moisture.
  • Soil and crop selection with rule-based crop suitability suggestions and seasonal guidance.
  • Text-based farming Q&A, with optional voice input and spoken responses.

Tech stack

  • HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript; no framework or build step.
  • Leaflet for the interactive map.
  • External data services: Open-Meteo, NASA POWER, and Nominatim.
  • Browser geolocation and speech APIs.

Architecture: It’s a static, frontend-only app. index.html defines the screens, style.css handles styling, and script.js manages app state, API requests, crop rules, and page interactions. There is no backend or database; the app retrieves data directly from external services and keeps its working state in the browser.

Limitations: Crop matching and the Q&A assistant use predefined rules and keyword matching—not an AI model or a substitute for local agricultural advice. Soil moisture and regional climate data are estimates, not direct measurements of a specific field.

Source code: https://github.com/sathyag2009/agrinova

The static site can be hosted on Render using the repository root as the publish directory.
